Hi Stephanie / Marcus — so sorry about the no-show from our side. We had an internal legal emergency that ran over the window and the calendar attendee didn’t update. Apologies for the inconvenience.

We reviewed your redlines briefly and attached our annotated notes (Zenith_Redline_Notes_Anika.docx). High level comments: 
- §3 (Liability): we propose a narrower liability cap tied to annual fees — see comments in the docx.
- §4.2 (Data handling): need explicit language about subprocessor notifications and KMS ownership.
- SLA: we can accept your baseline uptime but request an explicit credit structure rather than an automatic termination right.

We can do a make-up call; propose these slots: 
- Thu 16 Jul — 15:00–15:30 ET
- Mon 20 Jul — 10:00–10:30 ET

If you prefer to exchange redlines asynchronously, we can also have our counsel produce a tracked version by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks —
Anika Rao
Procurement Manager | Zenith Health Systems
anika.rao@zenithhealth.com
(attachment: Zenith_Redline_Notes_Anika.docx)
